preconditions.name: enough_testable_seeds
preconditions.note: 3/6 seeds are TESTABLE (surrogate-BPTT depth-3 ceiling holds AND depth-2 underfits); need >= 3. Per-seed ceiling-gating: a seed where the ORACLE cannot fit on spikes carries no depth-3 info. If ZERO seeds are testable, there is NO valid spiking depth-3 instrument at this scale -> UNDEFINED (the honest instrument-limit map, NOT a fabricated negative).

preconditions.name: lever_kp_changes_fit
preconditions.note: the KP-vs-freeze-Y fit-gap-close lever MOVED. If it did NOT (KP == frozen-Y), the deep credit is dead at this depth and no verdict is earned -> UNDEFINED.

preconditions.name: backprop_oracle_ceiling_exists
preconditions.note: mean surrogate-BPTT depth-3 loss 0.006833 <= 0.01007 (12% of var 0.08392) on testable seeds

preconditions.name: depth_separating_on_fit
preconditions.note: mean BPTT depth-2 0.01573 > depth-3 0.006833 by > 0.004196 (5% of var): the tent^k target is depth-3-ENGAGING on FIT on the LIF SNN

preconditions.name: fixed_dfa_baseline_fails_to_reach_layer3
preconditions.note: fixed-DFA closes 100.4% of the BP2->BP3 fit gap (< 50%) -> it does NOT reach the deep layers on spikes. This is the baseline KP must beat.

preconditions.name: permuted_target_does_not_learn_fit
preconditions.note: KP on per-step-reshuffled targets: loss 0.04177 >= 0.5*bp2 0.01573 -> no fit from a signal-free target

preconditions.name: lever_KP_moves_feedback
preconditions.note: seq_kp updated Y_fb every step (feedback-learning ON); freezing it (seq_fixed) left Y_fb unchanged=True

preconditions.name: transport_free_not_a_copy_of_Wt
preconditions.note: max |cos(Y_fb, W^T)| at INIT = 0.296 (< 0.8 -> NOT a copy; a W^T copy reads ~1.0). Y_fb is a SEPARATE random stream; the credit path reads Y_fb not W^T; KP updates Y_fb by the matched Adam-step transpose. cos(Y_fb,W^T) RISES through training (deep init 0.155 -> final 0.994) -> co-adapted, not transported.

preconditions.name: transport_free_no_byte_copy
preconditions.note: no Y_fb is byte-equal any forward W or its transpose, all seeds

preconditions.name: substrate_seeded_deterministic
preconditions.note: two fresh builds at one seed give byte-identical forward weights (substrate RNG = default_rng(seed); this runner does not touch the bridge, so there is no cfg.seed to mis-set)

preconditions.name: kp_fit_differs_from_fixed_dfa
preconditions.note: the KP fit must differ from the fixed-DFA baseline's fit (the manipulation landed)
